Lumen third-party notices
=========================

Lumen is licensed under the GNU AGPL v3 (LICENSE.txt in this folder).
It ships or downloads the following third-party components.
Settings > About > Third-party licences shows the same list.

Bundled with the installer
--------------------------
Electron (MIT) - https://github.com/electron/electron
  Includes Chromium and Node.js; their licenses are in LICENSES.chromium.html and
  LICENSE.electron.txt next to Lumen.exe.

sherpa-onnx / sherpa-onnx-node (Apache-2.0) - https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
  Offline speech-to-text and wake-word spotting.

ONNX Runtime (MIT) - https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
  onnxruntime.dll, shipped inside the sherpa-onnx-win-x64 package.

NVDA Controller Client 2.0 (GNU LGPL-2.1) - https://www.nvaccess.org/
  native/nvdaControllerClient.dll, unmodified. License and source in nvda/.
  You may replace this DLL with any compatible build or delete it; announcements
  then fall back to Lumen's own voice.

Rust crates in lumen-native.exe (MIT / Apache-2.0), including windows-rs, serde,
  serde_json, crossbeam-channel, libloading, tracing, fast_image_resize, base64,
  jpeg-encoder and cpal.

npm packages in the app bundle (MIT / Apache-2.0 / ISC / BSD-2-Clause), including
  @anthropic-ai/sdk, openai, @modelcontextprotocol/client, zod, dotenv,
  electron-updater, mammoth (BSD-2-Clause), react, react-dom, lucide-react (ISC),
  roughjs, perfect-freehand and @mediapipe/tasks-vision (Apache-2.0).

Downloaded on first use (not in the installer)
----------------------------------------------
Parakeet TDT-CTC 110M English (CC-BY-4.0) - NVIDIA
  https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt_ctc-110m
  License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
  Changes: converted to ONNX and quantized to int8 by the sherpa-onnx project
  (sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet_tdt_ctc_110m-en-36000-int8). Local speech-to-text model.

Canary 180M Flash (CC-BY-4.0) - NVIDIA
  https://huggingface.co/nvidia/canary-180m-flash
  License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
  Changes: converted to ONNX and quantized to int8 by the sherpa-onnx project
  (sherpa-onnx-nemo-canary-180m-flash-en-es-de-fr-int8). Downloaded only when the
  voice language is Spanish, German or French.

sherpa-onnx KWS zipformer GigaSpeech 3.3M (Apache-2.0) - wake-word model.
  https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx

Vosk small English model 0.15 (Apache-2.0) - https://alphacephei.com/vosk/
  Only downloaded when the wake-word fallback is used.

MediaPipe Face Landmarker model and Tasks Vision WebAssembly (Apache-2.0) - Google
  https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
  Downloaded only when face gestures are turned on.
